users_contact_present.name: users_contact_present
users_contact_present.value: "users"."phone" is not null or "users"."email" is not null

services_reference_range.name: services_reference_range
services_reference_range.value: "services"."reference_min_paise" is null or "services"."reference_max_paise" is null or "services"."reference_min_paise" <= "services"."reference_max_paise"

worker_profiles_base_in_india.name: worker_profiles_base_in_india
worker_profiles_base_in_india.value: ("worker_profiles"."base_lat" is null and "worker_profiles"."base_lng" is null) or ("worker_profiles"."base_lat" between 6 and 37 and "worker_profiles"."base_lng" between 68 and 98)

bookings_priced_when_confirmed.name: bookings_priced_when_confirmed
bookings_priced_when_confirmed.value: "bookings"."status" not in ('CONFIRMED','EN_ROUTE','ARRIVED','IN_PROGRESS','COMPLETED','DISPUTED') or ("bookings"."worker_id" is not null and "bookings"."agreed_price_paise" is not null and "bookings"."accepted_offer_id" is not null and "bookings"."slot" is not null and "bookings"."confirmed_at" is not null)

bookings_cancellation_recorded.name: bookings_cancellation_recorded
bookings_cancellation_recorded.value: "bookings"."status" <> 'CANCELLED' or ("bookings"."cancelled_at" is not null and "bookings"."cancelled_by" is not null)

worker_ledger_entries_booking_required.name: worker_ledger_entries_booking_required
worker_ledger_entries_booking_required.value: "worker_ledger_entries"."type" not in ('JOB_EARNING', 'COMMISSION', 'CASH_COLLECTED') or "worker_ledger_entries"."booking_id" is not null

dispute_evidence_content.name: dispute_evidence_content
dispute_evidence_content.value: "dispute_evidence"."storage_key" is not null or "dispute_evidence"."note" is not null

disputes_resolution_recorded.name: disputes_resolution_recorded
disputes_resolution_recorded.value: "disputes"."status" not in ('RESOLVED', 'REJECTED') or ("disputes"."resolved_by_admin_id" is not null and "disputes"."resolved_at" is not null and "disputes"."resolution_note" is not null)
